Pokémon GO Mega Squads: what to finish before September 14

Mega Squads adds Maschiff and Mabosstiff, a new Super Max Mega Level, and a GO Pass that closes at 8 p.m. local time on September 14.

By PlayScout EditorialAugust 31, 2026Source checked · Pokémon GO
Player impact

Mega Squads adds Maschiff and Mabosstiff, a new Super Max Mega Level, and a GO Pass that closes at 8 p.m. local time on September 14.

PRIMARY SOURCEPokémon GOOpen the original announcement ↗

Explore real-world locations, build raid teams and collect Pokémon through live events. This briefing keeps the player-facing consequence close to the source and links to the original announcement for complete details.

What was announced

Pokémon GO’s Mega Squads event runs September 8–14, 2026. Maschiff and Mabosstiff make their debut, with Maschiff appearing through eggs, Field Research and the event GO Pass. The official announcement also introduces Super Max Mega Levels for Mega Beedrill and Mega Houndoom.

What it means for players

For the September 13 Spotlight Hour, the official schedule lists Houndour and a possible Houndoom encounter from 6–7 p.m. local time. Before spending resources, check the current GO Pass milestones and which encounters still matter to your collection.

What to check next

GO Pass progress ends September 14 at 8 p.m. local time, while unlocked rewards expire September 16 at 8 p.m. local time. Open the in-game event screen and the original announcement to confirm availability in your region before paying for the Deluxe pass.
